title: LifeTether
description: All players share one life. One death ends it for everyone.
body:
## 🔗 LifeTether 
Transforms your world into a high-stakes group challenge where all players share a single life. Every player in the world is linked by a tether — when one person dies by any cause, the tether breaks and everyone dies together.

### 🔧 Features:

- One shared life pool for all Survival/Adventure players
- Lightning flashes on wipe for dramatic effect
- Works seamlessly in all 1.21.x versions

### 🔥 LifeTether is ideal for players who want: ###  
- A hardcore co-op experience
- Shared responsibility for survival
- Tense decision-making with friends
- Funny moments with friends

### 📖 This datapack is enabled by default when added to your world, and works perfectly in: ### 
- Singleplayer
- LAN sessions
- Multiplayer servers

### ⚙️ Toggleable at any time using:

- /function lifetether:on
- /function lifetether:off

### ℹ️ Extra Information:
- A Discord server may be created in the future for updates and communication.
- Known limitation: In Minecraft 1.21–1.21.8, the datapack may not display the initial startup message in yellow/gold text (see the In-game text image). Functionality is unaffected.
